question: Camera traps watched 34 southern hairy-nosed wombat burrows on an island for six months. What was recorded using them most?
answer: Black-footed rock-wallabies. On Wedge Island in 2015 they were logged using burrows 1,795 times, against 1,674 for the wombats that dug them. Bettongs, skinks, dragons and little penguins came too. A warren is a public building: the owner is only one of many tenants coming in from the heat.
move: Ask who else uses a thing before crediting it to its builder.
trap: People only see wombats at burrows, so wombats seem the main users.
